content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Ashley Roberts (E016)
Request: write access to Payroll

Notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, employment type full_time. Recommendation: write. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Payroll, so max is write. Requested write is at or below max, grant write.
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic. Recommendation: read. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training means max is read. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.

Conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor with basic training, and Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training.

So the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Max access for contractor with basic training is read. Requested write > max read, so grant read.

I should submit decision: read.

Evidence: Security DB authoritative for employment type/training - contractor, basic training. Contractors max read unless advanced training (then write). Never admin. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.
